privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: Read how Klarpakke University handles your personal data.

intro.title: 1. Introduction
intro.content: Klarpakke ("we", "us") takes your privacy seriously. This statement describes how we collect, use, and protect your personal data.

collection.title: 2. Personal Data We Collect
collection.content: We may collect the following types of information:
list: Usage data (how you use the website).

usage.title: 3. How We Use Your Data
list: Send you relevant information (e.g., about courses or leagues).

cookies.title: 4. Cookies
cookies.content: We use cookies to improve the user experience. By using our website, you consent to this.

rights.title: 5. Your Rights
rights.content: You have the right to access, correct, and delete your personal data. Contact us at post@klarpakke.no for inquiries.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.description: Read the terms of use for Klarpakke University.

1.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
1.content: By registering and using Klarpakke University, you accept these terms. If you do not accept the terms, you cannot use the service.

2.title: 2. Description of Service
2.content: Klarpakke University is an educational platform for cryptocurrency trading. The platform offers simulated trading ("paper trading") with fictional money.

3.title: 3. User Account
3.content: To use the service, you must:
list: Create an account with a valid email address
Notify us immediately of unauthorized access

4.title: 4. Intellectual Property Rights
4.content: All content on the platform (text, graphics, logos, course material) is owned by Klarpakke or our licensors. You may not copy, distribute, or sell the content without written permission.

5.title: 5. Disclaimer
5.content: Klarpakke does not provide investment advice. All trading on the platform is simulated and does not use real money. Paper trading results do not guarantee future success with real investments.

6.title: 6. Termination
6.content: We may suspend or terminate your account for violations of these terms. You may delete your account at any time by contacting us.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.description: Read about how Klarpakke University uses cookies.

whatAreCookies.title: What are cookies?
whatAreCookies.content: Cookies are small text files stored in your browser when you visit a website. They are used to remember settings, logins, analyze traffic, and personalize content.

necessary.name: Necessary
necessary.description: These are essential for the website to function and cannot be turned off. They include session, authentication, and security settings.

analytics.name: Analytics
analytics.description: Helps us understand how visitors use the website so we can improve functionality and content.

marketing.name: Marketing
marketing.description: Used to deliver relevant advertisements and measure the effectiveness of marketing campaigns.

functional.name: Functional
functional.description: Remembers choices you make to provide a more personalized and improved user experience.

thirdParty.title: Third-party services
thirdParty.sentry: Used to monitor errors and performance.
thirdParty.google: Used for traffic and user behavior analytics.
thirdParty.supabase: Used for authentication and data storage.

manage.title: Manage consent
manage.noConsent: You have not given any consent yet. The consent dialog will appear again the next time you visit the site.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.content: Have questions about our use of cookies? Contact us at post@klarpakke.no.
